gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-meetei: Almendra Display brings an ornate, storybook flourish, its letters never pinching shut and its x-height standing proud. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek is the sans-serif beneath it.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikakui: Sleek, futuristic, and a bit like a row of glowing tiles: that's Audiowide. And Noto Sans Mende Kikakui follows with a sans-serif whose curves all show daylight, so scale it up if you want it to hold its ground.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and a bit weighty through the middle of each line, its curves held open instead of curling shut. Oswald is the confident, tightly knit voice above it, and that tension is the pair's real draw.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-meroit: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, with letters that never pinch shut and a pronounced x-height. Noto Sans Meroitic then keeps things approachable, its see-through openings letting lowercase fill each line almost like capitals.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi reads clean and modern, with daylight inside every curve and little gap between capital and lowercase height. Audiowide sits above it, futuristic and tile-like, with no thick-thin shift.
gen-fredoka-fs-sentient: Fredoka draws every line at a single width, with an open e that shows a clear gap. But Sentient is more pinched and sophisticated, its crossbars a touch thinner than its stems.
gen-fs-oswald-manrope: Oswald packs its rows tightly, confident and strong, with a modest lowercase and some thick-thin variation. Yet Manrope keeps a bright opening in every curve and a single pen width, so lines feel open and approachable.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono reads sturdy and spacious, its tall lowercase making words look large while generous openings fill every curve. And Almendra Display adds ornate, literary character above, so the page has both ceremony and clarity.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-mro: Audiowide sets futuristic, tile-like glyphs with no thick-thin shift, while Noto Sans Mro looks dense and tall in the middle. Their shared strength is that tech-minded modernity.
gen-fs-oswald-satoshi: Oswald stands confident and tightly knit, with a moderate lowercase height and some stroke variation. Satoshi then opens things up with a soaring x-height and a wide e, every stroke cut to a single width.
